pkgmetadata.longdescription:
SimpleX Chat is a private messenger that has no user identifiers of any kind. This is a -bin package of its CLI: upstream's own .deb (the ubuntu-22_04 build, the same one install.sh fetches) is unpacked and its 79 MB Haskell binary installed as /usr/bin/simplex-chat, so its libcrypto/libgmp linkage is owned and preserved by Portage instead of rotting in ~/bin the way the old hand-dropped copy could.
The CLI doubles as a bot-API server: it is normally started by hand, for example `simplex-chat -p 5225 -d ~/.simplex/simplex_v1`, and local clients (such as the simplex-xmpp-bridge workspace project) talk to it over ws://127.0.0.1:5225. The API is unauthenticated and unencrypted by design, so that port must never be exposed.
Upstream advertises a curl-based self-update in `--version` output; this package supersedes it (bump PV, refresh the Manifest, emerge).
